sources.name: Colin Soria
sources.quote: You know, it's not the kind of weather that stops you in your tracks—just that dull, gray blanket that makes everything feel a little slower. I've noticed it in the way people move, like we're all carrying an extra weight we can't quite name. Even my usual rounds feel heavier, like the cold's seeped into my bones and decided to stay. It's not bad, exactly, just... there. Makes you want to hunker down, keep to yourself a little more than usual.

sources.name: Melton Neilon
sources.quote: You know, when it's this kind of flat gray for days, I notice my regulars come in quieter, like they're carrying the weather inside with them. Even the dough feels slower to rise—not bad, just... deliberate, like it's thinking harder about whether it wants to wake up today.

sources.name: Elio Perez
sources.quote: The overcast days make everything feel slower, like the world is holding its breath. It’s not gloomy, just... neutral, and it makes me want to stay inside, keep things simple, and not push too hard.
